headline: Why loneliness is now seen as a harmful epidemic for mental and physical health
subtitle: In France, nearly one in four people reported feeling lonely in 2025. This isolation particularly affects young people and the elderly, and could be a significant source of suffering. Among the possible ways to counter it are taking part in local activities and encouraging more volunteering.

headline: In this French city, social diversity in schools has almost disappeared
subtitle: According to studies, the southern city of Perpignan is the most educationally segregated in France. It's divided between private schools, which rank among the most privileged in the country, and public schools, which, in almost every case, sit at the exact opposite end of the social scale.
